title: Discipline Lead – Lighting (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Lighting-specific BIM content as it relates to architectural, theatrical, and show lighting fixtures, positions, power/data distribution, and documentation delivery.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Lighting discipline BIM states for use in show/technical and documentation milestones
Sign-off authority for Lighting documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Lighting scope and enterprise standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure Lighting BIM models support accurate lighting plots, schedules, and pipe/truss positions
Align Lighting resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve fixture focus angles, photometrics, and maintenance clearances
Formally approve Lighting BIM models for documentation use based on externalized monitoring data
Review Lighting data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Lighting BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (lighting plots, instrument schedules, fixture details)
Lighting participation in BIM coordination workflows
Lighting BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: Lighting discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
Lighting instrument schedules and plot drawings
inputs: Lighting design concepts, fixture cut sheets, and circuiting plans
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: Lighting plots, schedules, and mounting details
